from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,runpy
out=Path('verification/A04'); module=runpy.run_path(str(out/'delivery_check.py'))
print(json.dumps(module['verify'](Path.cwd()),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
report=out/'交付入口修复报告.md'; raw=report.read_bytes();assert b'\r' not in raw and not raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf')
manifest=out/'candidate-delivery-manifest.json'; assert hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() in raw.decode('utf-8')
for item in json.loads((out/'delivery-fix/final-fingerprints.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['files']:
 p=Path(item['path']);assert p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
for p in sorted((out/'delivery-fix').glob('*-command.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
 for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
  f=p.parent/r[stream+'File'];assert f.stat().st_size==r[stream+'Bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r[stream+'Sha256']
print('正式修复报告UTF8LF、所引用当前manifest SHA、最终指纹及全部已完成修复检查双流通过')
